source.title: 올리브영 서울 매장 주소록 · 매장 사진 (2026-09-18)
source.coverage: One official representative image per store, as shown on the Olive Young store finder; not a full gallery.
source.matching: A store maps to a catalogue place only when its official store name equals the place's Korean name (올리브영 prefix and spacing ignored) and the road-name address agrees. Event posters and Olive Better stores are excluded; a place that already carries owner photos is left untouched. Stores whose catalogue place is not published yet (district-level fallback pins, unverified curated rows) are excluded until the pin is verified; their official address is kept for that follow-up.
source.rights: Images are the brand's own store-listing photos compiled by the owner. The owner confirmed on 2026-09-18 that publishing them in the app is permitted; they are not user or third-party listing photos.
